title: UNOFFICAL Glitch Production Plushies
description: This project Aims to add Characters from Popular Glitch Production Shows and turns them into marketable plushies! So far this is still very new and only adds Murder Drones and Digital Circus is being in the works.
body:
This adds Marketable Plushies from Glitch Productions and even any varients if they have any from the shows. This will in the future aim to add Murder Drones. The Amazing Digital Circus. And Gameoverse and more.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial fan-made modification. Murder Drones and all associated characters, designs, and voice lines are owned by GLITCH Productions and created by Liam Vickers, Gooseworks and more. No copyright infringement is intended; this mod is a non-profit tribute made purely for the community to enjoy.

Characters & Audio: All voice lines, character designs, and names belong to GLITCH Productions (YouTube: [(@GlitchProd)](https://www.youtube.com/@GLITCH)).
